description:
Despite the number on this issue saying it is # 10 it is really the first issue of the Ziff-Davis comic G. I. Joe.

Ziff-Davis had the habit of starting new magazines at number 10 (or sometimes 2 or 6 and even from time to time at #1) which was common enough at that time, Z-D however also had the peculiar practice of changing the numbering if a series if it turned out to be popular. (few of their comics lasted more than 5 issues)

They did this with G. I. Joe so that that after the 5 issue (numbered 14) they called the next issue # 6, meaning, if you just looked at the covers, there were two number 10s and no 1-5.
Despite the number on the cover this is really # 2.
While the cover says 12 this is really  # 3
The fourth issue of G. I. Joe

• G.I. Jokes by Vie Martin
  • G.I. Joe in Swenson’s Menagerie
  • Pvt. Dopey in Carnival Capers! by Vic Martin
  • G.I. Parade by Vic Martin
  • G.I. Joe Presents A Classic Tale Of Men In Battle - …and they came near…
  • Mike The Mule Skinner and Adolf by Brown and Gantz
  • G.I. Joe in A Gopher Named Smith
  • Out Private War!
  • Army Chuckles by Vie Martin

It's a Foot Soldier's Job! starring G.I. Joe; Sam Daily, a new war correspondent, learns what it is really like to be at war.

Korean Family Man starring G.I. Joe; Joe "adopts" a puppy and a young Korean boy.

Frankie of the Pump! starring Buddies; Frankie, the cook for Baker Company, quits after a new guy, Henshaw, insults his cooking because it doesn't taste like rations.

23 Notches for Zeb! starring G.I. Joe; Zeb receives news from home that his father is ill.

Shell Shocked starring The Yardbirds.

The Corporal's Tree starring G.I. Joe.

Facts about the Garand Rifle.

A Replacement starring Wendy the WAF, Wendy joins the WAF to take over a man's job, but once the Air Corps spotted her in uniform they wanted to take over the girl for whom no one could find a replacement.

Reinstated! Part 1 of 4.

The world's greatest task force returns! When secret government technology disappears into thin air, the clues lead to the unbelievable. Cobra, the ruthless terrorist faction of the 1980's, hell-bent on world domination... is back! Only a highly elite squadron of "Real American Heroes" can stop them: G.I.JOE! Old favorites return to usher in a new era of G.I.Joe, and to shut Cobra down before they can slither their way back into American life.

Dreadnoks! Dreadnoks! Dreadnoks! That's right, this issue is chock full of them, and everyone's favorite pink-haired Dreadnok returns. This issue begins a new arc that will finally let everyone know just what Zarana thinks of her bossy niece, and how the Joes are keeping tabs on the dangerous bikers. Recommended for readers and fans of G.I.Joe is a sure win with anyone into high adventure, military action, and more. It's an action story that plots the U.S. military against a team of near-super villains, and a great nostalgia kick to boot.

COBRA's latest experiment terrorizes the Dreadnok compound in Chicago, but when its path of destruction spreads out into the city streets, G.I.JOE intervenes. However, COBRA is not about to let them go home with their new technological wonder.

Everything comes to a head, and it's Action Action Action! It's hard enough for G.I.JOE to stop the renegade Battle Android Trooper (BAT), but will the DREADNOKS and the ALLEY VIPERS be too much for our favorite task force to handle? Of course not, but it'll be fun to watch them take the bad guys out.

"He's one of the most dangerous men alive. Feared by members of G.I. Joe and Cobra alike, he hasn't been seen in years. This December marks the return of the enigmatic saboteur known as FIREFLY. But whose side is he on?"

Rock N Roll reunites with former G.I. Joe teammates, Mutt with Junkyard, Alpine, and Bazooka in the small town of Delhi Hills. Expecting a quiet weekend of rest and relaxation, they soon discover that the local tavern they are visiting is actually an underground meeting hall for Cobra sleeper agents.

Rock N Roll reunites with former G.I. Joe teammates, Mutt with Junkyard, Alpine, and Bazooka in the small town of Delhi Hills. Little did they know that the town was filled with Cobra sleeper agents, and the four soon found themselves in the middle of an explosive situation. After a harrowing escape and the arrival of G.I. Joe reinforcements, the group discovered that all evidence of the Cobra front had disappeared...

Cover Girl, Spirit and Snake Eyes investigate a series of child disappearances with strange similarities.  The team finds the missing children, but are unable to rescue them due to mysterious circumstances.  The three G.I. Joe agents return to the newly reformed PIT with an eerie feeling they will encounter the children again...

An international coalition of criminals and mercenaries kidnap Flint and Baroness in and effort to discover the whereabouts of the elusive Cobra Commander. G.I. Joe joins forces with Destro's forces to rescue the missing agents Aided by former October Guard members, Daina and Lieutenant Gorky, the alliance takes them to the Czech Republic. However there is a traitor among them...

Teams comprised of both G.I. Joe and Destro's operatives entered the Czech Republic in an effort to rescue the kidnapped Flint and Baroness. While one team made headway in learning the captives' whereabouts, the other comprised of Scarlett, Daina, Paige Adams and the Crimson Twins (Tomax/ Xamot) are set up and captured thanks to the betrayal of Lt. Gorky. Ironically Flint and Baroness escape on their own, but will they be able to help their teammates in time?

Teams comprised of G.I. Joe and Destro's operatives successfully rescue Flint and Baroness from General Moskin and his group bent on destroying Cobra Commander. The mission does not go smoothly though as one operative is killed in the fray. The G.I Joe team returns to America, bringing back a new agent, Daina.

REINSTATED: Part Two

ENOUGH TALK - It's time to save the world. In the second installment of this four-part story arc, G.I.JOE of old meets the new recruits - for the first time giving the team standardized, entry level TROOPERS. GUNG-HO, STALKER, SNAKE-EYES and SCARLETT are sent with a small squadron to ZARTAN'S DREADNOK compound to capture the COBRA hierarchy before they start their evil plan. What the Joes don't know is that it's already too late. Meanwhile, on the Cobra front, tempers flare and troops are on edge as DESTRO forces his way into the seat of power. Find out what this means for COBRA COMMANDER this November!

Storm Shadow breaks free of Cobra Commander's years of mind control and escapes to a safe house in Los Angeles. He contacts Billy, Snake-Eyes and Kamakura to get their help him enter the Arashikage mindset and permanently overcome Cobra's brainwashing. Cobra Commander discovers Storm Shadow's location and wants his ninja bodyguard back...

Snake-Eyes, Kamakura and Billy attempt to help Storm Shadow, who has temporarily broken free of Cobra Commander's years of mind control. However, Cobra Commander intercepts the group before Snake-Eyes is able to secure Storm Shadow's mental state through ancient ninja techniques. A battle ensues and destroys a small part of Los Angeles, while Storm Shadow reaffirms his allegiance with Cobra, leaving Snake-Eyes to the realization that his friend is lost.

General Hawk is ordered by The Jugglers to escort a group of mysterious children - who turn out to be clones of the former Cobra emperor, Serpentor - to a military base where they could be better cared for. Believing that The Jugglers intend to actually destroy the children, Hawk defies the orders and attempts to re-route them to a safer facility. However, the convoy transporting the children gets intercepted by none other than Serpentor; alive and looking for revenge.

Cobra Commander is kidnapped by Serpentor's Coil forces, with the aid of former Dreadnok - Zandar. Serpentor reveals a horrifying plan to disable the planet's cities and finally achieve his one true ambition, global domination. Meanwhile, General Hawk finally informs his troops about the return of G.I. Joe's greatest threat, and begins to reinstate all former agents...

Serpentor makes the first strike in his plan to take over the world. Meanwhile, Cobra Commander and a small group of captured G.I. Joe members escape Serpentor's prison on Cobra Island, but not without a price... a member gets seriously injured trying to protect the team.

Hawk leading the G.I Joe team and Destro leading the Cobra forces join together in an assault on Cobra Island to stop Serpentor's Coil army and his plans of world domination. Cobra Island in the battlefield for three armies. After the dust settles, Serpentor is pushed out, G.I. Joe heads home and Cobra takes over the island once again. But what will happen with the children, the 9 clones of Serpentor?

Flash, Mainframe, Skidmark, and Chuckles are killed in this issue.

issue_title: Scott Sturgis is a Reasonable Man...
description: The Cobra Island battle is over, but there's a lot of healing to do. As the Joes pay tribute to their fallen friends, Duke discovers a possible security breach. How far will he go to keep the team's secrets? How could a conspiracy geek named Scott Sturgis possibly be the most dangerous man on the planet? And who's the new guy?

When Cobra Commander and Storm Shadow come out of hiding in Tibet, the Joes make their bid to take them down. Once they arrive, however, Scarlett and the other Joes are shocked to see how far Snake-Eyes will go to bring his former sword brother to justice! Meanwhile, the Cobra forces led by Tomax and Xamot take a major step towards rebuilding their power base; and Destro makes a decision that may or may not be a surprise to everyone around him. All this and more in a story we could only call "The Paradigm Shift!"

"Players and Pawns" Part 1 of 6: While the Baroness chooses between love and duty, Cobra Commander and Destro make bold moves to secure their own positions. Meanwhile, Snake Eyes returns to face the repercussions of his drastic decision, the Joes have a graduation ceremony and some fresh faces join a new campaign against Cobra's forces. All this and Sierra Gordo under siege in Part 1 of the first full-length story arc!

PLAYERS AND PAWNS: Part 2 (of 6), Cobra Commander has returned to power, but our heroes barely have time to worry about that! While Barrel Roll sneaks around on Cobra Island, the team regroups after a very public attack on their leadership. Elsewhere, Destro and his Iron Grenadiers prepare for their first major operation since leaving Cobra. Meanwhile, the jungles of Sierra Gordo are alive with the sound of combat as Recondo, Ripcord, Dart, Low-Light, and Tunnel Rat face down a group of high-tech commandos determined to leave the tiny nation in ruin. It's action in the jungle and manipulation in the shadows as "Players and Pawns" continues!

"Reinstated, Part 3 of 4"
 
The Joes try to figure out the nano-mites as much of the team is infected. Spirit and Kamakura are sent to recruit Billy to help them rescue Snake Eyes and Scarlett. The mystery of Destro is revealed.

PLAYERS AND PAWNS: Part 3 (of 6), Cobra Commander has returned to power, but our heroes barely have time to worry about that! While Barrel Roll sneaks around on Cobra Island, the team regroups after a very public attack on their leadership. Elsewhere, Destro and his Iron Grenadiers prepare for their first major operation since leaving Cobra. Meanwhile, the jungles of Sierra Gordo are alive with the sound of combat as Recondo, Ripcord, Dart, Low-Light, and Tunnel Rat face down a group of high-tech commandos determined to leave the tiny nation in ruin. It's action in the jungle and manipulation in the shadows as "Players and Pawns" continues!

The walls are closing in on all sides, and both G.I. Joe and Cobra are feeling the squeeze. Destro is a prisoner of the U.S. government, but how long will that last? Will Duke be suspended from the G.I. Joe team? What is Cobra Commander going to do now that Zartan has quit? And exactly what kind of trouble did Snake-Eyes and Scarlett get into? We've got answers galore as the "Players and Pawns" story arc heads toward its shocking end!

PLAYERS AND PAWNS: Part 5 opf 6, Not a hoax! Not an imaginary tale! As 2004's first full-length story arc races to its conclusion, we find the Joes under siege and a revelation around every corner! In the final moves of a massive game, the major players make their bids to gain the advantage. When the dust settles, everything has changed... and you'd better believe there's a shocking surprise ending! Also in this issue: Part Two of "Fantome" by Brandon Jerwa and Talent Caldwell! Just who is Wraith, and what does he have to do with DESTRO's forces?

THE ROAD LESS TRAVELED, In this shocking epilogue to the "Players and Pawns" (part 6 of 6) storyline, Brandon Jerwa and Tim Seeley take us on a journey to the edge of one man's very existence. This is the story that people will be talking about for a long time to come... are you prepared? Find out when we walk upon "The Road Less Traveled!" Plus! The Wraith 3-part back-up story reaches its finale in this issue! Created by Jerwa and designed by Superman and Aspen artist, Talent Caldwell, the mysterious new villain Wraith is destined to shake up the G.I. Joe universe! Don't miss out on the final chapter of Wraith's debut!

"BAD MOON RISING": Part 1 (of 2), Cobra Commander has been dealt with, but no one is celebrating. Tragedy has cast a dark shadow over the G.I. Joe team, and the command structure is straining from the pressure. While Duke and General Colton face down the Jugglers, Cobra regroups with a new agenda and a broader power base, thanks to their recent "acquisition" of new troops. Meanwhile, a team of Joes descend on a quiet town in Colorado, only to find betrayal behind every door... and in their own ranks! This two-part story features the debut of Blackout and the battle you just knew was coming... Snake-Eyes vs. Wraith!

"Bad Moon Rising" Part 2 of 2, The GI Joe team is under fire from all sides: Cobra, The Coil, The Jugglers...and now the public! As the administration hangs our heroes out to dry, Cobra pounds the final nail in the coffin. It's wall-to-wall action and backstabbing evil as Destro rises to power... only to find a big surprise waiting for him when he reaches his goal. All this and the conclusion of the Snake-Eyes/Wraith showdown in "Bad Moon Rising" Part 2!

issue_title: Union of the Snake Part One: Shroud
description: UNION OF THE SNAKE Part I, The Joes are facing a time of crisis unlike any other in their history. Hawk has been crippled, and has left the team. The international media is crucifying them for their apparent role in a tragedy on US soil. Cobra, under Destro's leadership, are more powerful than ever before. And now, the team is being broken apart... Meanwhile, Destro continues to consolidate his power, driven by the major revelation he learned last issue. And he draws ever nearer a goal he has long sought, one which would make him the single most dangerous man on the planet...

"UNION OF THE SNAKE" Part 2, The arc that will rock the Joes' world continues! The team is crumbling! Between discharges and arrests, what was once America's elite counter-terrorist force is but a fading shadow. Their government has turned its back on them, the Jugglers have moved in for the kill...but a new hope has emerged. His name is General Phillip Rey, and he may be the Joes' last, best hope, whether they like it or not! Meanwhile, Scarlett is determined to free Snake-Eyes from prison?and finds help from a very surprising ally!

issue_title: Union of the Snake Part Three
description: UNION OF THE SNAKE: Part III, Even as the Joes' world continues to crumble around them, Destro marshals the forces of Cobra,  while the Dreadnoks embark on what seems to be a suicide mission. One which ends with a moment nobody ever thought would happen! Meanwhile, Duke, Snake-Eyes and Scarlett have become fugitives, and the man charged with their capture may be the Joes' last hope to prevent the absolute ascendance of Cobra!

Union of the Snake Part 4 of 6. The Newly-unmasked Cobra Commander is free , and has Destro and the Baroness in his crosshairs for their betrayal! Meanwhile, Cobra launches an all-out assault on the PIT, something that will leave an already-faltering Joe team in an even more vulnerable state. That is, until their all-new commanding officer steps in.

"Reinstated" Part 4 (of 4)

Destro unleashes the nano-mites on America and chaos ensues. All communication from Washington DC has been cut off, and the Joes must go in blind. This issue wraps up the story arc that brought G.I.JOE back to comics and lays the foundation for many more stories to come. Perhaps the most action packed issue yet, the Joes' battle with Cobra takes them right up to the white house lawn! Yo Joe! Recommended for readers and fans of G.I.Joe is a sure win with anyone into high adventure, military action, and more. It's an action story that plots the U.S. military against a team of near-super villains, and a great nostalgia kick to boot.

UNION OF THE SNAKE: Part 5 (of 6), The arc that will shatter the Joes' world races towards its conclusion! While General Rey wins the trust of his new charges, the decision is made to take extreme action to take Cobra out once and for all. And as Destro reels from personal loss, Cobra Commander activates the Tempest, a doomsday weapon unlike any other, and stands at the very brink of world domination. Meanwhile, the fugitive Snake-Eyes, Scarlett and Duke find a very nasty surprise.

"UNION OF THE SNAKE" Part 6 of 6: The conclusion!, The United States government has already used the ultimate weapon at its disposal to strike at Cobra, but has that merely played into Cobra Commander's hands? Armed with the Tempest, he now has the ability to inflict death on biblical proportions. The Joes have seen their roster greatly diminished, and yet, they are all that stands between the world and a Cobra-led conflagration. And waiting in the shadows is a third entity, one which has the power to destroy G.I. Joe and Cobra alike...

DAWN OF THE RED SHADOWS: Part 1, The Dawn of the Red Shadows is at hand, and with it, the End of G.I. Joe as you know it! They've vowed to destroy both Cobra and G.I. Joe... but who ? or what ? are the Red Shadows? What is their agenda? In the past few months, the Joes have seen some of their most legendary members injured or killed. They've been made scapegoats and had their ranks greatly reduced. Can General Rey, Flint, and Lady Jaye rally what's left of the team, and defeat an adversary that may prove to be their greatest challenge ever? This is it ? the storyline that leads directly into the biggest G.I. Joe event ever!

Special Double-Sized Issue!!! Rise of the Red Shadows, the Conclusion! This is it, the End of G.I. Joe as you know it! The enigmatic Red Shadows have thrown the world into a state of utter chaos and violence. Who will pay the ultimate price? And will a rag- tag group of Joes be enough to prevent the Red Shadows' horrific vision from coming to pass? Leads directly into the biggest G.I. Joe event ever!

This issue takes place BEFORE the events of issue one and finally gives us a glimpse into the super-spy life of Duke before reinstating the Joe team. Better yet, this overseas adventure pits the Joe Sergeant against Cobra's most ruthless British mercenary, Major Bludd. Retailers, this is a stand-alone issue and a great jumping-on point for readers who missed the first story arc.

Starting an all-new story arc! Jump on now! Cobra Commander returns with a vengeance, and he's bringing STORM SHADOW along for help. Destro, meanwhile, decides the fate of his long lost son. On the G.I. Joe front, the Joes investigate a Cobra arms deal while Uncle Sam ponders just how many Joes they need now that Cobra is "gone" once again.

The order has been given for Storm Shadow to take out the G.I. Joe leader, General Tomahawk, and a new attack on Dreadnok weapons smugglers might have something to do with his plans. While the General deals with problems from higher-ups, the Joe infantry enter a world of hurt thanks to their new instructor, Beach Head. On the Cobra front, the Commander finally gives Destro a piece of his mind, right in his own castle! Recommended for readers and fans of Blackhawk Down, Twenty-Four, and anything to do with the now classic G.I. Joe comics, cartoons and toys!

Finally! Destro and Cobra Commander hammer things out, as Destro decides what to do concerning his son Alexander's abuse of the Cobra throne. The question is, will Cobra Commander listen to what the arms dealer has to say, or will he unleash the full wrath of Cobra upon him? Meanwhile, Storm Shadow continues his infiltration of the Joe HQ, while Beach Head gives the troops the most grueling training sessions of their lives.
This is it! The issue you've been waiting for. The world's two baddest ninjas go head to head in an Arashikage battle royal! Snake-Eyes. Storm Shadow. That's all you need to know.

issue_title: One Word;  In Or Out?;  Deep Cover
description: G.I. Joe has a new base of operations! IDW Publishing is proud to present an all-new era for the legendary Joe team. This specially priced introductory issue re-introduces the G.I. JOE vs. COBRA conflict for today's world, as presided over by G.I. JOE commanding officer, writer Larry Hama. Joining Hama on art chores is artist Robert Atkins. Together, the two tell their first tale-during a routine mission, the Joe team comes under attack by a mysterious outfit with terrifying goals.

A new beginning and a new world of threats for the fighting men and women of the elite military force known as G.I. Joe - Freedom's last hope and the first-to-fight in battle with a hidden enemy and a secret war that's already won! The world's terror underworld whispers of Cobra. Who or what is Cobra and what can the Joes do to stop an enemy they can't identify or find. Think you know Joe? Think again.

BATTLEGROUND: SPRINGFIELD! Snake Eyes goes mano y mano with COBRA for the first time and it's a fight that may leaved a whole town in ruins! Brutal, one-on-one action that will stop your heart! Also, Destro meets Dr. Mindbender at Sector Zero. And the Joes uncover yet another horrifying revelation about their newest enemy.

The first face-to-face confrontation between a JOE and a COBRA! It's SNAKE EYES vs. an unknown COBRA soldier in an epic fight to the death that neither of them may survive. Also: The JOES learn more of the true nature of the superweapon being built at Section Zero. And what has MAINFRAME learned that may lead to the end of the little town of Springfield?

The concluding issue of THE BETRAYERS arc! The ultimate fate of SCARLETT and SNAKE EYES! And DESTRO must prove his loyalty and value to COBRA or die! All are judged, some will live and one will die as this epic ends and a new one begins as the shadow war goes on! Don't go AWOL for this game-changer issue!

Artist Robert Atkins returns to the book to begin an all-new storyline where Tripwire joins the team. But his first mission may be his last, as Tripwire and Beachhead are trapped inside an ancient Mixtec ruin with an army of narco-terrorists hunting for them.

Snake Eyes and the Hard Master reunite as the Joe's silent bringer of death seeks the tutelage of his mentor. And a Cobra operative invades a college campus with deadly results for the Joes. The action builds as the M.A.S.S. Device moves closer to a reality!

The M.A.S.S. Device is activated and COBRA’s got it! A world-wide crime spree ensues as COBRA can send killers, thieves and spies anywhere in the world in an instant. No place on the planet is safe from their influence. Also, Duke and Scarlett are under arrest and another Joe is in a body bag!

The Baroness is having a really bad day at the top of the world. The M.A.S.S. Device is malfunctioning. Destro's causing problems. Cobra Commander is demanding results. And to add to her troubles, a hit team of master snipers has her in the crosshairs. Not a lot of job security in COBRA.

Snake Eyes is once again under the tutelage of his mentor the Hard Master, but to make himself whole once again, the silent Joe must find a student of his own. Also, Destro is banished to a remote COBRA gulag and if you think he's going to stay there, well, you don't know James McCullen Destro.

What starts as a desert survival exercise for the Joes turns into a fight for survival, with COBRA soldiers sent to find the Pit. Unarmed and out of communication, Covergirl, Downtown, and Tripwire must outwit, outlast, and outkill COBRA's best if they want to stay alive and prevent the disclosure of the Pit's secret location. The start of an all-new storyline, featuring art by S.L. Gallant (G.I. Joe Origins: Mainframe).

The M.A.S.S. Device tips the balance of power in the COBRA’s favor in a big way. And Destro is a guest of Major Bludd in the COBRA gulag known as Section Ten. But Destro has a plan and that means a rising body count on the Siberian tundra.

The Pit, the G.I. Joe headquarters, has been infiltrated and Cobra will claim the first victim. Meanwhile, Snake Eyes has gone awol and his actions are being questioned by his friends, except for Scarlett who still trust in him. In some unknown location, Destro is making his move and he receives the unexpected visit of the deadly Baroness.

Ripcord joins the series as he leads Scarlett and a team of Fobbits on a jump to a faraway tropical island. But it's no day at the beach because COBRA owns this little slice of paradise and means to keep it. Also, Shipwreck and his crew of pirates in action against the Dreadnaught; COBRA's gigantic submarine-cruiser. It's a perfect storm of action and suspense!

Action at crush depth as Shipwreck and his crew board a massive COBRA submarine to take control. But the clock is ticking as a nuke set in a deep underwater trench could blow, killing them and dooming Scarlett and Ripcord. This special image and its incentive cover pay homage to the classic G.I. Joe #21 “silent issue” from yesteryear!

The Joes battle Mother Nature as a tidal wave threatens to sweep Scarlett, Ripcord and their strike team off an abandoned COBRA atoll. At the same time, Shipwreck, Cover Girl and the others have captured a COBRA weapon of mass destruction. But can they hold onto it? Action, mayhem, and post-nuclear consequences on the high seas!

Helix arrives in the Pit to join the JOEs' struggle against the threat known as COBRA, and proves she's tough enough in combat with the deadliest JOE. Also, STALKER and his team go man to man in a fight to the death with a COBRA strike team...

“M.A.S.S. Destruction” continues as Mainframe and Dial-Tone engage in long-range combat in the Hindu Kush using predator drones. They bring the fight to COBRA from ten thousand miles away and learn that, even in a virtual war, the heart can be a casualty. See StormShadow in action, and also, what will a captured COBRA Viper reveal to the Joes?

'M.A.S.S. Destruction' blows up as the Joes go to WAR! It's a full mobilization to intercept COBRA in a narco-terrorist state in the midst of civil war. The Joes are jumping into the fire to bring the fight to their greatest enemy, while Helix and Snake Eyes have a strategy all their own that hits COBRA where it hurts!

'M.A.S.S. DESTRUCTION' rolls on as Snake Eyes and Helix battle alone in COBRA's lair. The two deadliest Joes are stranded with no hope of rescue and are surrounded by hundreds of COBRA troops. This is the bullet-riddled and sword-flashing confrontation Joe fans can't miss!

"M.A.S.S. DESTRUCTION" concludes with Snake Eyes and Helix stranded at the top of the world in a desperate battle against time, the elements and COBRA. Expect an armored vehicle battle on the frozen wastes of an Arctic wasteland like you’ve never seen before. And a chilling shock ending you never thought you’d see!

The Pit is under siege by high-tech invaders controlled remotely by weapons genius Destro. All of the Joes' lives and secrets are on the line as they fight for their existence against machines programmed to kill in a deadly game of cat-and-mouse inside the Joes' secret lair. And it doesn't go easy for Destro as his current client sends the Baroness to terminate their contract... with prejudice.

How does COBRA work out disputes with its sub-contractors? It's cold-blooded murder as Destro and Baroness battle to the death inside the walls of Castle Destro! All this while the Joes battle mechanical terrors to take back The Pit. Wall-to-wall, cover-to-cover action.

The battle in The Pit becomes a chase across the Nevada desert. Only one of Destro's mechanized killers is left and it's the most dangerous. Meanwhile, Flint is figuring out Where in The World is Castle Destro. And in Manila, Snake Eyes shows up as Stalker is closing in on a runaway arms dealer... but on whose side?

The first epic story of G.I. Joe draws to an explosive conclusion as Snake Eyes hunts for the man who can lead him to the secrets of COBRA. But first the Joes' silent warrior has to face down Destro, who's willing to risk a fate worse than death to prove his worth.

Scarlett on trial! The Joe's red-haired super-spy is court martialed and facing execution unless she can prove COBRA's existence. Her only hope is SNAKE EYES and he's half a world away. And how will the arrival of a new recruit code-named COVERGIRL change the Joes forever? A new story begins and this is where YOU sign up!

No one holds the Baroness against her will… not even Destro. Scarlett remains on trial and the evidence is mounting. Mainframe and Snake Eyes on a roadtrip? The Joes invade the relocated Castle Destro only to find someone—or something—deadly at home. Jam-packed and action-wracked as this hard-charging series roars to new heights.

The Joes invade Castle Destro only to find no one home but the biggest, baddest killer robot ever and the encounter turns deadly for the team. We also pay a visit to the ultra secret Section Zero—COBRA’s arctic lair where Destro must make the M.A.S.S. Device perform or die. And Mainframe and Snake Eyes on a road trip to… Springfield?

With Cobra Commander deceased, long live Cobra Commander, but what everyone wants to know is, who will be the new Cobra Commander? The role must be filled and the deadliest and sneakiest Cobra elite will compete to become the new ruler. The deciding factor will be whoever kills the most G.I. Joes!

COBRA ON THE ATTACK! The new COBRA COMMANDER begins a global strategy to turn the super-secret cabal into a legitimate world power. But those plans are only known to the highest levels of COBRA, and the invasion of a sovereign Southeast Asian country continues. The Joes and UN Forces are outmaneuvered and outgunned in a war of total annihilation!

The Commander demands annihilation! COBRA’s horrific war escalates and the Joes are fighting for their lives in the killing fields. The new Cobra Commander unleashes weapons of unimaginable horror in a scorched earth strategy that will turn the Southeast Asian country of Nanzhao into a lifeless wasteland. Will the Joes stand or run? You already know the answer to that one, don’t you?

COBRA COMMAND AFTERMATH! It's a new day for the JOEs—as they crawl from the ruins of COBRA COMMAND, they find a new status quo… and a change in command! “Deep Terror, part 2!”

Under-staffed, under water, and under the gun! The new stripped-down Joe team battles a very public Cobra as Dr. Mindbender drills on the ocean floor—but what’s he looking for? And how will Scarlett and her team escape?

“Deep Terror, part 3!”

DEEP TERROR rumbles on! Scarlett and Team Bravo are on the loose in a COBRA mining operation, miles beneath the surface of the Earth, with no chance of escape. In this issue they uncover the objective of Dr. Mindbender's subterranean search: a rare element that will allow COBRA to change the world forever. And that's NOT Good!

DEEP TERROR concludes! Scarlett and Team Bravo are trapped a mile beneath the Earth’s surface with an army of COBRA killers beneath on their tail! Their only hope is—Mainframe? Also: COBRA’s too-public campaign to destroy the Joes rolls on. How can America’s super-secret heroes survive in the light of day?

DEEP TERROR Epilogue! COBRA's scheme to take the Joes public goes viral. America's most secret fighting force is on the run! COBRA COMMANDER dispenses his own rewards for failure. Copperback a prisoner of the JOEs! And SCARLETT learns that SNAKE EYES is still alive and confronts Helix in an encounter only one of them may survive!

TARGET: SNAKE EYES starts here! Maybe SNAKE EYES should have stayed dead! The JOES are mobilized to hunt down their most dangerous quarry ever: one of their own. Has the silent Joe gone over to the other side? Is he playing his own game? Only Snake Eyes knows the answer.

'Target: Snake Eyes,' Part Three! Scarlett leads the Joes on a campaign to put an end to the Arashikage Clan forever. But Serpentor and the murderous zealots of the Inner Coil may beat them to it. Snake Eyes knows the world has turned against him and he's surrounded on all sides by danger. Just the way he wants it!

Storm Shadow and Zartan invade The Pit! One can't be killed and the other can't be seen! At the same time, General Hawk and Dial-Tone are being stalked by an army of killers in our nation's capital. They're on the run with no one to trust. The Cobra Civil War is just getting started!

TARGET: SNAKE EYES hurtles toward its shocking conclusion! SERPENTOR'S FANG BRIGADE closes in on the Arashikage refuge deep in the jungle. HELIX and SNAKE EYES battle for their lives surrounded on all sides by warring foes. The G.I. JOE team rides to the rescue-but will they find a battlefield or a graveyard?

General Hawk is retired from G.I. JOE, but COBRA isn't through with him! A team of elite snakeheads targets the former honcho for capture and interrogation. But old soldiers never die, they kick butt and take names. Big one-against-all action as an outnumbered and outgunned Hawk shows us how he earned those stars.

The COBRA CIVIL WAR roars on! General Hawk is hunted by a squad of desperate killers in the nation’s capital! The Pit is under attack by Stormshadow and Zartan and mercy is NOT in their vocabulary. The contest to decide who will be Cobra Commander gets bloodier. Can the Joes survive?

The Pit destroyed! The Joes on the run! General Hawk under arrest! Team Alpha exposed to a lethal virus! The Cobra Civil War takes another deadly turn as the contest between the baddest of the bad grinds on. The prize? The role of Cobra Commander!

The Joes go underground—literally! They’ve been on the defensive for the last four months, and now they’ve got a plan to get out of the line of fire, regroup, and start painting Cobra with red, white, and blue butt-kicking! That is, if Cobra doesn’t find them and kill them first... Zartan and Baroness are scheming, and that can’t be good for the Joes!

Costa, Gage and Fuso take you on the final steps toward oblivion, and re-introduce yet another forgotten member of COBRA, just in time to make the trip just a little more dangerous.

Xamot’s wild, unbridled actions have come under the gaze of the Commander, as is evident when all of his clearance is suddenly revoked. Tomax, on the other hand, still retains what little power the Paoli’s have, and stays in the Commander’s good graces. All of this proves to be a façade however, a bid by Xamot to take control of Cobra, a coup. Xamot subdues and replaces Tomax, assaults a unit of Vipers, and creates chaos, framing Chuckles in the process. However, the Commander was aware of Xamot’s plan and placed Chuckles in his path, a promise to the former Joe that he would get revenge on his enemy. In that final moment, Chuckles declares his true allegiance and assassinates the Commander, fulfilling his original mission. As Chuckles fights one of the Crimson Guard, Xamot escapes. Chuckles promises to destroy ever Cobra between himself and the door.

Notes:

  • The cover is a homage of the cover of Alpha Flight #12.

After the shocking events of last issue, all bets are off for the last chapter of Chuckles' undercover saga. He'll have to face enemies, friends... and, finally, himself. Costa, Gage, and Fuso finally bring one of the most shocking GI Joe stories of all time to a close, and not everyone is getting out alive.

General Hawk's new operative has found Chuckles... who's in no mood to be rescued. And considering how his last handler ended up, maybe she should take his advice and leave him alone. Meanwhile, delve deeper into Cobra's twisted inner circles as Tomax and Xamot are called before the high command.

Chuckles is in the wind and doesn't care if he lives or dies. All he wants is revenge. But the Joes need him in one piece... and getting him means following him into the belly of the beast. Or, in this case, the reptile—COBRA.

The plans of Cobra, Chuckles, and the agents following him all collide. Can anyone survive? Will the Joes get what they want from Chuckles... by any means necessary? And brace yourself for a last page that will impact the entire line of G.I. Joe books!
